newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGS slip on NYMEX losses.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGS slip on NYMEX losses.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices fell Wednesday in moderate activity amid sharp losses on NYMEX crude oil and gasoline futures, players said.
July NYMEX futures took a dive Wednesday following the release of oil inventory data that showed growing gasoline supplies.

As NYMEX fell, U.S. Gulf Coast spot propane sunk a half cent to between 33.74 cents and 34.00 cents a gallon. Conway, Kansas, material traded as low as 35.00 cents this morning but picked up following an 11,000-barrel deal at 35.25 cents.
"We went down because of the Merc," said a Conway player.
Meanwhile, there was talk that a small ship was loading 8,000 tonnes or propane out of the U.S. Gulf Coast for the Mexican Parajitos port. It could not be immediately confirmed.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
